findings.evidence: The attributes occur at lines 103, 108, 168, 239, and 245. Unlike `presentation` at line 256, these definitions have fixed types (`Fin 11`, lists, or functions on `Fin 11`) and can be characterized propositionally without casts or reindexing.
findings.fix: Remove these five `@[expose]` attributes and add characteristic equations (`branchNode_eq`, `arms_eq`, `neighbors_def` or `mem_neighbors_iff`, `adjoinedRelators_eq`, and `relatorList_def`); retain `presentation_transcribed_append` as the higher-level presentation API.
findings.issue: `branchNode`, `arms`, `neighbors`, `adjoinedRelators`, and `relatorList` are all `@[expose]`, making downstream code depend on implementation bodies although none has the dependent-index requirement that justifies exposing `presentation`.

summary: Several data definitions expose their bodies even though stable characteristic lemmas can provide the required audit interface; the exposure of `presentation` itself is justified by the dependent Coxeter API.
